events.title: MTV Launches with Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star
events.blurb: MTV launched with the Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Thirty-six years ago, MTV launched and changed music forever, kicking off with the Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star.

events.title: Oasis Release Definately Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album Definately Maybe in 1994.

angles.name: Oasis Debut
angles.copy: Oasis' debut album Definately Maybe was released thirty-two years ago and marked the start of the Britpop era.

events.title: Woodstock Festival Took Place
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: The legendary Woodstock Festival took place fifty-seven years ago, changing music history with its incredible performances.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: We remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll on the anniversary of his passing, forty-nine years ago.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot Dead in Las Vegas
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Shakur Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost Tupac Shakur, a talented artist whose legacy lives on.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a guitar legend, Jimi Hendrix, whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Release
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Beatles released Abbey Road, one of the most influential albums in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the lead singer of The Pretenders, turns 75.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic voice behind The Pretenders, turns 75, a legend in the music industry.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the Oasis frontman, turns 54.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Liam Gallagher, the voice of Oasis, turns 54, continuing to rock the music scene.

events.title: John Lennon Releases Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: John Lennon's powerful album Imagine was released fifty-five years ago, a timeless classic in music history.

events.title: Apple Releases the First iPod
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Release
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple revolutionized music with the release of the first iPod, changing the way we listen to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated on October 5th.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day, a celebration of the iconic spy who has captivated audiences for decades with his style and sophistication.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today, a legendary musician and peace activist who left an indelible mark on the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the British comedian and actor, turns 87.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: John Cleese, the legendary comedian and actor, turns 87, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: Beatles Release White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic White Album in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Release
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, the Beatles released their groundbreaking White Album, a seminal work in music history.
